inspectedSubsystems.findings: Identified and fixed inverted Tag 1212 mapping in sbp/fiscalReceiptService.ts (goods_with_marking vs goods_without_marking). Re-aligned to statutory FTS Order ED-7-20/662@ and FiscalReceiptFactory.

inspectedSubsystems.subsystem: 3D Lab Scans & Mock Storage Security / Tenant Isolation
inspectedSubsystems.findings: Patched security vulnerabilities in portalMockStorageRoutes.ts: enforced org_<id>/ prefix, restricted file extensions to ALLOWED_SCAN_EXTENSIONS (STL, PLY, OBJ, DCM, ZIP), guarded against disk exhaustion with MAX_SCAN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES (500 MB), and enforced 403 cross-tenant isolation.
Added missing composite index idxClinicalAuditOrgCreated on (organizationId, createdAt) in clinicalAuditLogs table to prevent expensive sequential scans on slow HDD/weak clinic hardware.
All Zod schemas for visits, receipts, split payments, and prosthodontic lab orders are synchronized and build cleanly without drift.

remediatedDefects.defect: Tag 1212 values for marked goods were inverted: goods_without_marking returned 32 and goods_with_marking returned 33.
remediatedDefects.fix: Reversed to statutory standard: goods_with_marking returns 32, goods_without_marking returns 33.

remediatedDefects.defect: Missing file extension validation, missing tenant isolation check, and no payload size limits.
remediatedDefects.fix: Added regex check for org_<id>/ prefix, whitelisted ALLOWED_SCAN_EXTENSIONS, enforced 403 on cross-organization access, and added MAX_SCAN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES ceiling.

remediatedDefects.defect: clinicalAuditLogs had only single-column organizationIdIdx, causing slow scans for audit trail sorting.
remediatedDefects.fix: Added idxClinicalAuditOrgCreated composite index on (organizationId, createdAt).

remediatedDefects.defect: Test suite lacked security tests for extension validation, key prefix verification, and cross-tenant access.
remediatedDefects.fix: Added 3 new unit tests covering 400 on .exe, 400 on unscoped keys, and 403 on cross-tenant requests.
